scheme_name: Ganesh Shankar Vidyaarthi Shramik Puraskar Rashi Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a worker employed in a registered factory, commercial establishment, or shop in Uttar Pradesh
Monthly salary (basic pay + dearness allowance) must not exceed ₹15,000
The applicant’s child must have passed the 10th, 12th, undergraduate, or postgraduate examinations
benefits_summary: Scholarship of ₹5,000 for students scoring 60‑74.99% and ₹7,500 for those scoring 75% or more in their respective exams.
